pages.text:
Introducing the all-new
2020 Atlas Cross Sport

Panoramic sunroof
With an available panoramic sunroof that’s almost
5 feet long, things are looking way, way up.
Front and rear heated seats
Help keep all of your passengers toasty when it
gets cold with available heated seats in both the
front and rear outboard seats.
Spacious 2nd row
A roomy 2nd row means no more arguing
about the front seat.
Cargo space
Comfortably carry what you need with 77.8 cubic
feet of space with the rear seats folded down.
Exterior styling
A raked roofline emphasizes its modern and
sporty design.
R-Line trim
The Atlas Cross Sport R-Line trim (later availability)
features unique bumpers and badging.
Advanced LED headlights and LED taillights
Illuminate your path with the available advanced
LED headlights. You can also enjoy efficient and
long-lasting LED taillights.
21” wheels
Available bold, five split-spoke in two-tone
machined alloy wheels are encouraged.
Always ensure cargo is properly secured. See Owner’s Manual for details.

pages.text:
4MOTION® All-Wheel Drive with Active Control
With the turn of a dial, you can switch between
four different all-wheel-drive modes to the one
that fits your current driving situation.
Engine power
Driving just got more fun with a 2.0L 4-cylinder
engine with 235 hp (achieved with premium fuel)
and 258 lb-ft of torque—or available 3.6L V6
engine with 276 hp and 266 lb-ft of torque.
Towing capacity*
When properly equipped with a factory-installed
towing hitch, the available 3.6L V6 engine can
safely tow up to 5,000 lbs.
FEATURES
• 2.0L TSI® turbocharged engine
• 8 -speed automatic transmission with
Tiptronic® and Sport mode
• Start-Stop System
AVAILABLE FEATURES
• 3.6L V6 FSI® engine
Image shown for illustration purposes only; actual feature may vary.
*Maximum tow rating when equipped with V6 engine and factory-installed towing hitch. Vehicle load, other accessories, and options may reduce maximum towing capacity. See vehicle Owner’s Manual for details.
